audit: ULTRON System Intelligence Mission 2 Independent Audit

findings.title: hostStatus ignores UNKNOWN observation statuses
findings.evidence: The host aggregate degrades only for DEGRADED, UNAVAILABLE, or FAILED. A CPU observation can be UNKNOWN when os.cpu_count() returns None, yet that alone does not prevent hostStatus from being VERIFIED.
findings.impact: The host-only status can overstate evidence. The overall status still has independent service identity, readiness, and manager ownership gates, so this does not enable overall VERIFIED when those gates fail.
findings.regression: No deterministic test currently covers an UNKNOWN host observation.

findings.title: Listener-present readiness behavior is not deterministic in tests
findings.evidence: Assertions compare readiness to UNKNOWN if the host happened to report a listener, otherwise UNAVAILABLE. They do not force a listener-present fixture.
findings.impact: Source currently maps a listener to UNKNOWN, but that exact condition is not locked by a deterministic regression.

findings.title: Complete changed-file scope cannot be independently established
findings.evidence: Mission 2 declares nine files. Running git status --short --branch in the repository exited 128 with fatal: not a git repository.
findings.impact: The report-declared files can be reviewed, but this audit cannot certify there were no other pre-audit modifications. No clean Git diff is claimed.

implementation_notes: Current service readiness construction produces UNKNOWN when a listener is present and UNAVAILABLE when absent; it does not produce VERIFIED. Consequently, with current code the aggregate cannot attest to overall verified service readiness.
The managerHandoff response is a read-only preflight, not a transfer implementation; eligible is always false.
The gateway uses the configured operator principal for inventory and helper restart paths.

The manager control endpoint accepts only operation=restart-auth and a validated operation ID. The manager compares recorded process identity including start ticks before helper signaling and validates replacement identity and readiness before success.

validation.pylance_python_syntax: No syntax errors reported for collector and collector test.
validation.pylance_diagnostics: No diagnostics for collector and collector test.
validation.problems_tool: No errors for collector, collector test, or operator-console.js.
validation.lint_typecheck: No separate configured lint/type-check command found in root pyproject.toml or interface/package.json.

limitations: No live service, database, or runtime state was accessed or modified.
No authenticated live browser or end-to-end verification was performed.
The focused tests rely on temporary fixtures and mocks for controlled cases.
Git metadata is unavailable, so a complete changed-file inventory cannot be independently confirmed.

final_conclusion.source_level_implementation: VERIFIED for the targeted identity, readiness, managerHandoff, authentication, and fixed-operation boundaries, with A-01 hostStatus issue documented.
